sinks.title: Streaming sinks
sinks.description: Ship every new audit entry to syslog, an HTTPS webhook or S3 compatible storage. Delivery is at least once and resumes from a saved cursor.
sinks.notConfigured: Audit streaming is not available on this control plane.

empty.title: No streaming sinks
empty.description: Add a sink to keep an off-box copy of the audit log.

card.secretOnce: New signing secret, shown once. Copy it now.
card.deleteDescription: Streaming stops and the delivery history is removed. Entries already delivered stay at the destination.

form.description: Credentials are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
form.name: Name
form.keepCredentials: Leave blank to keep the stored credentials
form.backfill: Also stream the retained history, not only new entries
form.secretOnce: Signing secret, shown once. Receivers verify the signature header with it.
